summary: Frontend-only QA of the Phase-1 redesign (Expo web, 390x844 + 320x700). One real PIN login; I reused that session in every other context by putting it into localStorage, so there was no 401/429 churn. Every non-GET /api/jl/** request was blocked by Playwright, except the read-only compare POST. Nothing academic was written. Series live, resume, done and embargoed states and the player (qa-mock-1) were tested only through route-interception fixtures. Almost all requested flows work: Home in both prelaunch and live fixture states; card state mapping and CTA targets; exam grid routing; MY TESTS stat to tab deep-link (including the repeat-tap case); the tab bar; hub streak card, today card and last-start countdown; day strip and day cards; score trend (Best/Avg, gold best, dashed gaps, point to /result/<id>); MY RESULTS toggle; the 62-day map scrolling to the strip; the whole player (timer amber at 8:58 and red at 1:38, options, mark/star, zoom 16->19px, clear, prev/next, next-subject, integer input, confidence, palette colours, legend and bubble jump, the per-subject submit table, exit sheet); exam hubs; PYQ (pills and year filter); catalogue (search, chips, pagination); set detail (Start and Save present, not pressed); My Tests (tabs, counts, search, clear, compare sheet, Open result); Mission; Account and all its sub-screens; Rapid Fire is unchanged. Defects found: (1) HIGH: the hub 'How it works' sheet opens off-screen. (2) MEDIUM: nested <button> on the Home Continue row. (3) Text clipping at 320px. (4) MINOR: an intermittent ignored first tap on exam-hub destinations, plus testID naming mismatches.

ui_bugs.component: All India hub 'How it works' explainer (DSheet)
ui_bugs.issue: Tapping series-tab-about dims the screen but the sheet is rendered off-screen: series-explainer bbox y=1032 on an 844px viewport. The user sees only a dark overlay. RCA: <SeriesExplainer> is rendered INSIDE the hub <ScrollView> (app/live.tsx:80). DSheet's sheetLayer is position:absolute top/bottom 0 with justifyContent flex-end, so it stretches over the whole scroll content and the sheet anchors to the bottom of the content, not the viewport. Fix: wrap the screen in <View style={{flex:1}}> and render <SeriesExplainer> after </ScrollView>, as account.tsx and tests.tsx already do.

Pressable inside Pressable: the home-continue-attempt Press wraps the Pill home-continue-resume (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:82-89). On web this renders <button> inside <button> and logs React errors ('<button> cannot contain a nested button' / hydration error), shown as a red dev error toast. Fix: make the inner Resume a non-pressable visual pill, or drop the outer Press.

Intermittent: on a fresh page load the first tap on exam-destination-* (bitsat mocks, jee-main chapters) right after the row appears is ignored (no navigation after 8s); a second tap works. Probable cause: the FadeInDown entering animation on each row (src/components/ExamHub.tsx:33) moves the row during the press, so the press is cancelled. Consider dropping the translate or using an opacity-only fade.

MEDIUM: Remove the nested Pressable on the Home Continue row (index.tsx:82-89).

Fix 320px clipping: player dock labels ('Mark for review' / 'Save & Next'), Live tile title and description, MY TESTS stat labels, the series card header wrap in the live state, and the hub credit line wrap.

critical_code_review_comments: TodayCard prelaunch copy hard-codes 'The first challenge opens 1 December.' (DayCards.tsx:20) instead of using istDate(series.first_date), while the eyebrow on the same card is already dynamic.
HomeSeriesCard embargoed state shows the badge 'COMPLETED' with a 'Results at 11:59 PM' CTA that routes to /live. Correct, but the CTA could be non-actionable or explanatory.
Data/sync/auth files were not touched; no mocks in production code.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (about 3 functional defects across ~45 checked flows, plus 320px visual issues)

seed_data_creation: None. No real attempts, saves, PIN changes or sign-outs. All non-GET /api/jl calls were blocked by Playwright except the read-only compare POST, which returned 409 for attempts from different papers, as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Log in once with entry-phone-input/entry-pin-input/entry-continue-button, save localStorage keys jl_sid and jl_user, then inject them via add_init_script in later contexts. Load the fixtures with exec(open(path).read(), ns), then call await ns['install'](page, variant) for the series (variant = live | resume | done | embargoed) or await install(page, deadline_secs, log) for the player. Open the player with history.pushState('/attempt/qa-mock-1') + popstate. The palette shows bubbles for the current subject only (palette-q-6+ appear after selecting palette-subject-chemistry). The real series is prelaunch (opens 1 Dec 2026).
rca_of_issue: Explainer off-screen: DSheet uses an absolute full-size layer with justifyContent flex-end. Inside a ScrollView that layer spans the full content height (about 1700px), so the sheet sits at the content bottom. Reproduce: open /live and tap series-tab-about; series-explainer bbox y=1032 > viewport 844. Mitigation: render it as a sibling of the ScrollView.
